info.title: CTMS API
info.description:
Campus Transport Management System.

Generated from the router — do not edit by hand. Regenerate with
`php artisan openapi:generate`.

Every response uses the envelope `{ success, message, data, code }`.
Paginated responses add a `pagination` object.
